name: h264-division-7c534afb
reason: Cause and counts of the H.264 decoder's division change, one c6g.4xlarge host (Graviton2) per target from the gate images: on 32-bit ARMv7 at main 256aa348, perf stat user-mode instructions, cycles and branch misses of the gate build of codec-worker and the reference on h264-high-1080p, perf records of both with symbol reports, and the callers of the integer division routines by sampled link register; the same counts at 7c534afb and main on the three H.264 workloads and hevc-main-1080p on both targets, with digests; the codec and H.264 crate tests on both targets; binaries' and inputs' SHA-256, toolchain and host details; cited by docs/status.md for the ARMv7 timing of h264-high-1080p.
